name: dee-field-scheduler
description: Field-measure & install scheduling + routing dashboard for window-covering crews

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.vercel-build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
